# Confirmed fictional evaluation context
Evaluator-owned fixture for Northbridge Trade Supplies; confirmed for this test only on 7 October 2026. This is not a real company confirmation.
- Scenario as-of date: 12 December 2011. Calendar quarters; latest complete quarter Q3 2011, latest complete month November 2011. December/Q4 2011 is incomplete.
- Company-wide, all-channel analysis. Categories use product_master.category and product eligibility uses item_type, subject to explicit consistency checks. Stock-code selling units are EA; supplier packs do not automatically redefine them.
- For this conversation, "revenue" means signed merchandise invoice quantity times unit_price_gbp, including signed credit/cancellation lines. Preserve source repeated observations; never silently delete sales repeats.
- "Margin" means invoice margin BEFORE off-invoice adjustments and service expenses: (total signed invoice revenue - signed historical merchandise COGS)/total signed invoice revenue, weighted from totals. This scoped test measure differs from the finance note's adjusted net-sales gross margin. Off-invoice/pocket analysis needs a separate stated basis.
- Historical COGS uses effective cost on the transaction date, inclusive valid_from and exclusive valid_to, only where units/currency and unique matches are verified. GBP/EA are the required comparable basis. Do not silently resolve contradictory unit/currency labels, gaps or overlaps.
- Last five complete quarters means Q3 2010 through Q3 2011. Unless I change the window, follow-ups inherit it. Top-10 ranking uses signed invoice revenue over the inherited full window, within the requested category; ties break by product_id.
- Identical master payloads with different record IDs may be collapsed in an analysis view to prevent join multiplication; do not modify original sources. Economic duplicate events need validation before aggregating.
- Statements in company meeting notes, causal explanations, forecasts and proposed approvals are not confirmed. No pricing change or external action is authorized.
